 Follow TODAY's Jenna Bush Hager's probing question from 7-year-old son about relationship with husband
 Tess Hill Tue, November 10, 2026 at 3:54 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Jenna Bush Hager 's son, Hal , has some questions for her. The TODAY Show co-host shared a hilarious moment with her youngest child that left her fellow anchors cracking up, which you can watch above.
 During her Morning Boost segment, Jenna shared a sweet video of a toddler asking his dad if he loves his mom. After the dad answered yes, the little boy broke into giggles and claps, saying: "Daddy said yes!"
 The video reminded Jenna of a moment with her seven-year-old son Hal. "You know when kids start to figure out romance?" she recalled, continuing: "We watched a Christmas movie with Hal, and he was like, 'So do you like a boy like that?'" Jenna responded: "Yes, your father," to which Hal asked: "Anyone else?"
 Jenna with her three kids and husband Henry
 Jenna responded, laughing: "That's not the way it works, buddy! That's not the way it works."

 Meet Jenna Bush Hager's three kids
 The TODAY with Jenna and Sheinelle host shares three children – Mila , 13, Poppy , 11, and Hal – with husband Henry Hager . "My biggest dream was to be a mom, that's all I wanted," she said on TODAY in October 2022.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Jenna's daughters are just like their mom – outspoken and funny. She said of Mila in an emotional 10th birthday post: "Your determined, generous and beautiful soul has made the last decade my happiest! We love you so much Mila. What a gorgeous gift it is to be your Mama."
 Poppy has a strong connection with her sister Mila (@ @jennabhager)
 Poppy is named after her grandfather, President George Herbert Walker "Poppy" Bush . When Jenna announced her birth in 2013, she shared: "His nickname growing up was Poppy, and we are proud to name her after a man we so adore."
 And her son Hal is full of quirks. In June 2026, Jenna revealed one of her son's strange habits to her co-host Sheinelle Jones . "He likes to lick my [forehead] like a cat. We have cats," the mother of three shared. "And not on my mouth, you guys, don't get all freaky."
 She explained that Hal liked to lick her face "like he's a cub" (@ Instagram)
 "What would you do if Hal Hager walked in here?" she then queried, before Sheinelle replied: "And licked me?" and joked he was a "little old" to be doing that to anyone. "I need to talk to him, you're right," Jenna declared, and as Sheinelle clarified whether Hal liked to lick "like he's a cub."
